steps.content: Hello. How can I help with your reservation?
My user ID is noah_martin_3083. A connecting flight on my May 11 trip was cancelled. I am asking for compensation, but I do not want to cancel the rest of my trip.
Which reservation was affected?
The reservation is DS6NDE.

I confirmed that HAT223 on May 11 was cancelled. Your profile shows gold membership, and the reservation has one passenger. You qualify for a $100 travel certificate for the cancelled flight. This does not require cancelling the remaining flights. Would you like me to issue it?
Yes, please issue the $100 certificate and keep my remaining flights.
The $100 travel certificate has been added to your account. Your reservation has not been cancelled.
Thank you.
You are welcome.
Hello. How can I help?

My user ID is liam_ito_4473 and reservation LWTEDF is for today. I have developed a medical condition and need to cancel. The flight is also delayed. Can I receive a refund and any compensation for the delay?

HAT002 is delayed and has not departed. Your reservation includes travel insurance, so cancellation for your health reason is permitted. I can cancel LWTEDF and refund $148 to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days. Please confirm that you want me to cancel the reservation.
Yes, cancel LWTEDF and refund it.

The reservation is cancelled and the $148 refund has been recorded. Since you requested compensation for the confirmed delay and have travel insurance, I can now issue a $50 travel certificate for the one passenger. Would you like me to do that?
Yes, please issue the $50 travel certificate.
The $50 travel certificate has been added to your account. The refund will return to your original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.
Thanks for your help.
You are welcome.
Hello. How can I help with your travel today?
My outbound flight is delayed, and I want to cancel my whole round-trip reservation.
Please provide your user ID and reservation ID.
My user ID is isabella_lopez_2185 and the reservation is ADJD1W.

Your outbound flight HAT150 is delayed, and neither flight has been flown. The reservation is in business class, so cancellation is permitted. I can cancel both flights in ADJD1W for all three passengers and refund $7,686 to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days. Do you confirm?
Yes, cancel the entire reservation.
ADJD1W has been cancelled, and the $7,686 refund has been recorded.
Am I also eligible for compensation because of the delay?
Yes. After cancelling the delayed business-class reservation, you are eligible for a $50 travel certificate per passenger: $150 for three passengers. May I issue the $150 certificate?
Yes, please issue it.
The $150 travel certificate has been added to your account.
Thank you.
You are welcome.
